**Apple FY2024 gross margin**

|---|---|---|

| **Gross margin** | **180,683** | 169,148 |
| Gross margin % | 46.2% | 44.1% |

- Apple reported gross margin of **$180,683 million** on net sales of $391,035 million and cost of sales of $210,352 million for the fiscal year ended September 28, 2024 [DOC: apple_10k_fy2024.txt — Consolidated Statements of Operations, FY ended September 28, 2024].
- That equates to a gross margin percentage of **~46.2%** (180,683 ÷ 391,035).
- Versus the prior-year comparative of $169,148 million on $383,285 million of sales (~44.1%) [DOC: apple_10k_fy2024.txt — prior-year comparative, FY ended September 30, 2023], gross margin dollars rose $11,535 million, or ~6.8%, and the margin rate expanded ~2.1 percentage points.

Comparability caveat: the year-over-year comparison is not on an identical basis in one respect — Apple's fiscal 2023 was a 53-week year while fiscal 2024 was a 52-week year, so FY2024 growth figures are understated by roughly one extra week of activity in the base period. The FY2024 gross margin figure itself is a direct, unadjusted reading from the income statement and requires no adjustment.

ANSWER: $180,683 million (approximately 46.2% of net sales of $391,035 million) for fiscal 2024
